name: Udimi Tools
author: webocoders

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress blog into a powerful marketing tool with Udimi Tools.

This plugin seamlessly integrates Udimi’s features into your site, giving you everything you need to grow your email list and boost sales.

✔ Automatically add Udimi tracking code to monitor leads and conversions
✔ Embed beautiful Udimi Lead Boxes anywhere on your blog
✔ Place Buy Solo Ad forms directly on your pages and start selling traffic instantly

No coding skills required — just connect your Udimi account and use the tools right inside WordPress.

With Udimi Tools, your blog becomes more than just content — it becomes a direct channel for building your audience and generating revenue.
sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Click on the “Udimi Tools” link on the left-side menu. It will ask you for an API key.
  3. Log into your Udimi account.
  4. Go to Settings > General and copy the key.
  5. Paste it on the plugin’s page.
  6. Click the “Save and connect” button.

You are all set!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Udimi account for this plugin to work?

Yes. To unlock all features (Lead Boxes, Buy Solo Ad forms, tracking) you’ll need a free Udimi account.
It only takes a minute to create and connect.

Can I customize Lead Boxes and Buy Solo Ad forms from WordPress?

All design and settings are managed directly in your Udimi account.
Once you’re done, simply insert them into your blog pages with Udimi Tools.

Do I have to pay to use this plugin?

No. The plugin is completely free to use.
However, free Udimi accounts have some limits. To remove them and get access to unlimited usage, just upgrade to Udimi Prime.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

Not at all. Udimi Tools is lightweight and optimized for WordPress.
It works smoothly with most modern themes and plugins.
